items.title: OS patching and upgrades with Amazon EC2 root volume replacement
items.summary: Amazon EC2 Replace Root Volume with the direct Amazon EBS volume option lets you prepare and validate a replacement root volume in advance, then swap it onto a running production instance with a single reboot. Learn how to upgrade the OS and apply patches while the instance keeps its production identity, including instances in Auto Scaling groups.
items.creator: Akshaya Shah
